name: io.github.oooooasis-fds/tsx-data
title: ooooOasis TSX Data
description: Canadian market data: 3,219 TSX/TSXV/CSE/CBOE securities, daily bars, filings, halts, short sales.

tools.name: tsx_list_securities
tools.description: List securities. Default 100 rows, max 1,000; truncated responses carry truncated=true + total. Free tier.

exchange.description: Exchange filter, e.g. TSX, TSXV, CSE, NEO.

q.description: Free-text search over symbol and company name.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (integer).

offset.description: Pagination offset: number of rows to skip (integer).

tools.name: tsx_get_security
tools.description: One security by id. Free tier.

security_id.description: Security id, as returned by tsx_list_securities (its 'id' field).

tools.name: tsx_get_bars
tools.description: EOD bars for one security. Default 252 rows, standard cap 252; full history needs explicit history=full. Free tier.

security_id.description: Security id, as returned by tsx_list_securities (its 'id' field).

from.description: Start date of the range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: End date of the range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD.

history.description: tsx_get_bars range control: omit for the default range (capped at 252 bars); set to 'full' for the full available history.

tools.name: tsx_get_bars_by_date
tools.description: Bars for one date. Default 100 rows, max 1,000. Free tier.

exchange.description: Exchange filter, e.g. TSX, TSXV, CSE, NEO.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (integer).

tools.name: tsx_get_meta
tools.description: TSX service metadata (snapshot time, registry counts). Public: no key needed, not counted.
